# 0 · The Dataset

- 24 subjects (repeated measures)  
- Factor: Condition (A = easy / B = hard), 2 levels, within-subject  
- 40 trials per subject per condition  

1 920 total rows

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(

```

# 1 · Libraries & Reproducible Seed

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling + ggplot2
library(patchwork)   # combine plots
library(scales)      # axis formatting
library(ggdist)      # raincloud / halfeye
library(lme4)        # mixed models (quick check)
library(knitr)       # tables
library(kableExtra)  # styled tables

set.seed(2024)
```

---

# 2 · Data Simulation

```{r simulate}
# ── Design ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 24 subjects (repeated measures)
# Factor: Condition (A = easy / B = hard), 2 levels, within-subject
# 40 trials per subject per condition  →  1 920 total rows
#
# Ground truth (population level):
#   Condition A (easy): higher accuracy, faster correct RT
#   Condition B (hard): lower accuracy, slower correct RT
#   Incorrect trials are on average SLOWER than correct ones
#   (post-error slowing + response uncertainty)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

n_subj      <- 24
n_trials    <- 40          # per subject per condition
conditions  <- c("A (Easy)", "B (Hard)")

# Subject-level random effects
subj_df <- tibble(
  Subject     = paste0("S", str_pad(1:n_subj, 2, pad = "0")),
  re_intercept = rnorm(n_subj, 0, 40),   # random shift in RT (ms)
  re_accuracy  = rnorm(n_subj, 0, 0.05)  # random shift in accuracy
)

# Trial-level data
sim_data <- expand_grid(
  Subject   = subj_df$Subject,
  Condition = conditions,
  Trial     = 1:n_trials
) %>%
  left_join(subj_df, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    # ── Accuracy ──────────────────────────────────────────
    # Condition A: p(correct) ~ 0.88 | Condition B: ~ 0.68
    p_correct = case_when(
      Condition == "A (Easy)" ~ plogis( 2.00 + re_accuracy),
      Condition == "B (Hard)" ~ plogis( 0.75 + re_accuracy)
    ),
    Correct = rbinom(n(), 1, p_correct),

    # ── Reaction Time (ms) ────────────────────────────────
    # Base RT: A = 480 ms, B = 560 ms
    # Incorrect trials are ~60 ms slower on average
    # Log-normal noise for realistic right-skewed RT
    mu_rt = case_when(
      Condition == "A (Easy)" & Correct == 1 ~ 480,
      Condition == "A (Easy)" & Correct == 0 ~ 540,
      Condition == "B (Hard)" & Correct == 1 ~ 560,
      Condition == "B (Hard)" & Correct == 0 ~ 625
    ),
    RT = rlnorm(n(),
                meanlog = log(mu_rt + re_intercept) - 0.5 * 0.18^2,
                sdlog   = 0.18)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Correct_f = factor(Correct,
                       levels = c(1, 0),
                       labels = c("Correct", "Incorrect")),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = conditions)
  ) %>%
  select(Subject, Condition, Trial, Correct, Correct_f, RT)

glimpse(sim_data)

write_csv(file="RT_data.csv",sim_data)
```

---

# 3 · Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptives}
# ── Overall summary ───────────────────────────────────────
desc_overall <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Condition, Correct_f) %>%
  summarise(
    N         = n(),
    Mean_RT   = mean(RT)   %>% round(1),
    Median_RT = median(RT) %>% round(1),
    SD_RT     = sd(RT)     %>% round(1),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

desc_overall %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 1 · RT summary by Condition and Response Correctness",
      col.names = c("Condition","Response","N",
                    "Mean RT (ms)","Median RT (ms)","SD RT (ms)")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(desc_overall$Correct_f == "Correct"),
           background = "#f0f7ff")

# ── Accuracy per subject x condition ─────────────────────
acc_subj <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  summarise(Accuracy = mean(Correct), .groups = "drop")

acc_summary <- acc_subj %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Acc = mean(Accuracy) %>% round(3),
    SD_Acc   = sd(Accuracy)   %>% round(3),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

acc_summary %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 2 · Accuracy by Condition (subject-level means)",
      col.names = c("Condition", "Mean Accuracy", "SD")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

# 4 · Visualisation

## 4.1 · Accuracy — the primary outcome

```{r plot-accuracy, fig.height=5}
# ── 4.1a  Subject-level accuracy + group mean ─────────────
p_acc_lines <- ggplot(acc_subj,
                      aes(x = Condition, y = Accuracy,
                          group = Subject)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey40", size = 1.8,  alpha = 0.7) +
  # group mean ± SE
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1),
               fun      = mean,
               fun.min  = function(x) mean(x) - sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)),
               fun.max  = function(x) mean(x) + sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)),
               geom     = "pointrange",
               colour   = "#2166AC",
               linewidth = 1.2,
               size      = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0.4, 1.05)) +
  labs(title    = "A · Accuracy per subject",
       subtitle = "Grey = individual subjects | Blue = mean ± SE",
       x = NULL, y = "Accuracy (% correct)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ── 4.1b  Raincloud of accuracy ───────────────────────────
p_acc_rain <- ggplot(acc_subj,
                     aes(x = Condition, y = Accuracy,
                         fill = Condition, colour = Condition)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.8, width = 0.5, .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.18),
    alpha = 0.70) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA,
               alpha = 0.5, colour = "grey30",
               position = position_nudge(x = -0.12)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("A (Easy)" = "#4393C3",
                                "B (Hard)" = "#D6604D")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("A (Easy)" = "#2166AC",
                                 "B (Hard)" = "#B2182B")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0.4, 1.05)) +
  labs(title    = "B · Accuracy distribution",
       subtitle = "Box | Points | Density",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_acc_lines + p_acc_rain +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 1 · Accuracy by Condition",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
  )
```

## 4.2 · Reaction Time — correct trials (primary focus)

```{r plot-rt-correct, fig.height=6}
rt_correct <- sim_data %>% filter(Correct_f == "Correct")

# Subject-level median RT (correct only)
rt_subj <- rt_correct %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  summarise(Median_RT = median(RT), .groups = "drop")

# ── 4.2a  Subject trajectories ────────────────────────────
p_rt_lines <- ggplot(rt_subj,
                     aes(x = Condition, y = Median_RT,
                         group = Subject)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey40", size = 1.8,  alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1),
               fun      = mean,
               fun.min  = function(x) mean(x) - sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)),
               fun.max  = function(x) mean(x) + sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)),
               geom     = "pointrange",
               colour   = "#1A7A4A",
               linewidth = 1.2,
               size      = 0.9) +
  labs(title    = "A · Median RT per subject (correct trials)",
       subtitle = "Grey = subjects | Green = mean ± SE",
       x = NULL, y = "Median RT (ms)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ── 4.2b  Raincloud of RT (correct) ──────────────────────
p_rt_rain <- ggplot(rt_correct,
                    aes(x = Condition, y = RT,
                        fill = Condition, colour = Condition)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.8, width = 0.55, .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.18),
    alpha = 0.70) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA,
               alpha = 0.5, colour = "grey30",
               position = position_nudge(x = -0.12)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("A (Easy)" = "#74C476",
                                "B (Hard)" = "#238B45")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("A (Easy)" = "#41AB5D",
                                 "B (Hard)" = "#005A32")) +
  labs(title    = "B · RT distribution (correct trials)",
       subtitle = "Box | Points | Density",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_rt_lines + p_rt_rain +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 2 · Reaction Time — Correct Trials",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
  )
```

## 4.3 · RT full distribution — correct vs incorrect overlaid

```{r plot-rt-both0, fig.height=5}
# Density overlay: correct (filled) vs incorrect (outline only)
# Kept secondary: incorrect shown as dashed outline, smaller alpha

p_density <- ggplot(sim_data,
                    aes(x = RT, fill = Correct_f,
                        colour = Correct_f,
                        linetype = Correct_f)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.8, adjust = 1.1) +
  # vertical medians
  geom_vline(
    data = sim_data %>%
      group_by(Condition, Correct_f) %>%
      summarise(med = median(RT), .groups = "drop"),
    aes(xintercept = med,
        colour     = Correct_f,
        linetype   = Correct_f),
    linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Condition, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Correct"   = "#74C476",
               "Incorrect" = "#FC8D59"),
    name   = "Response") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Correct"   = "#238B45",
               "Incorrect" = "#D7301F"),
    name   = "Response") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Correct"   = "solid",
               "Incorrect" = "dashed"),
    name   = "Response") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(title    = "Figure 3 · RT density: Correct vs Incorrect",
       subtitle = "Vertical lines = median RT | Incorrect shown as dashed outline",
       x        = "Reaction Time (ms)",
       y        = "Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", colour = NA),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_density)
```

## 4.4 · Accuracy × RT trade-off per subject

```{r plot-tradeoff, fig.height=5}
# One point per subject x condition
# x = accuracy, y = median correct RT
# Reveals speed-accuracy trade-off at the individual level

tradeoff_df <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy  = mean(Correct),
    Median_RT = median(RT[Correct == 1]),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

p_tradeoff <- ggplot(tradeoff_df,
                     aes(x      = Accuracy,
                         y      = Median_RT,
                         colour = Condition,
                         shape  = Condition)) +
  # connect same subject across conditions
  geom_line(aes(group = Subject),
            colour    = "grey75",
            linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  # group-level ellipses
  stat_ellipse(level     = 0.80,
               linewidth = 1.1,
               linetype  = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("A (Easy)" = "#4393C3",
                                 "B (Hard)" = "#D6604D")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values  = c("A (Easy)" = 16,
                                 "B (Hard)" = 17)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(title    = "Figure 4 · Speed–Accuracy trade-off per subject",
       subtitle = "Each point = one subject | Lines connect same subject across conditions | Ellipse = 80% CI",
       x        = "Accuracy",
       y        = "Median RT — correct trials (ms)",
       colour   = "Condition",
       shape    = "Condition") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_tradeoff)
```

## 4.5 · Trial-by-trial RT time course (learning / fatigue check)

```{r plot-timecourse, fig.height=5}
# Smooth RT trajectory across trials within each condition
# Separate panels for correct / incorrect
# Useful to detect practice effects or fatigue

p_timecourse <- ggplot(sim_data,
                       aes(x      = Trial,
                           y      = RT,
                           colour = Condition,
                           fill   = Condition)) +
  geom_smooth(method  = "loess",
              span    = 0.55,
              alpha   = 0.18,
              linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Correct_f, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(
               Correct_f = c("Correct"   = "Correct trials",
                             "Incorrect" = "Incorrect trials"))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("A (Easy)" = "#4393C3",
                                 "B (Hard)" = "#D6604D")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = c("A (Easy)" = "#4393C3",
                                 "B (Hard)" = "#D6604D")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels  = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(title    = "Figure 5 · RT time course across trials",
       subtitle = "LOESS smooth ± 95% CI | Left = correct (primary) | Right = incorrect (secondary)",
       x        = "Trial number",
       y        = "RT (ms)",
       colour   = "Condition",
       fill     = "Condition") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", colour = NA),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold",
                                        size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_timecourse)
```

## 4.6 · Heatmap — subject × condition accuracy & RT

```{r plot-heatmap, fig.height=6}
# Two heatmaps side by side:
# Left  = accuracy (primary)
# Right = median correct RT (secondary)

heat_df <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy  = mean(Correct),
    Median_RT = median(RT[Correct == 1]),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # order subjects by mean accuracy for readability
  mutate(Subject = fct_reorder(Subject, Accuracy, mean))

# ── Accuracy heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────
p_heat_acc <- ggplot(heat_df,
                     aes(x = Condition, y = Subject,
                         fill = Accuracy)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(Accuracy, accuracy = 1)),
            size = 3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette  = "Blues",
    direction = 1,
    limits   = c(0.4, 1),
    labels   = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    name     = "Accuracy") +
  labs(title = "A · Accuracy",
       x = NULL, y = "Subject") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right")

# ── Median RT heatmap (correct trials) ───────────────────
p_heat_rt <- ggplot(heat_df,
                    aes(x = Condition, y = Subject,
                        fill = Median_RT)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Median_RT)),
            size = 3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette   = "Greens",
    direction = -1,          # darker = slower
    name      = "Median RT (ms)") +
  labs(title = "B · Median RT — correct trials",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y     = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")

p_heat_acc + p_heat_rt +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 6 · Subject-level heatmaps",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
  )
```

# 5 · Quick Mixed-Model Check

```{r mixed-models}
# ── 5a. Accuracy (logistic GLMM) ─────────────────────────
mod_acc <- glmer(Correct ~ Condition + (1 | Subject),
                 data   = sim_data,
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"))

cat("=== Accuracy model ===\n")
print(summary(mod_acc), correlation = FALSE)

# ── 5b. RT — correct trials only (LMM, log-transformed) ──
mod_rt <- lmer(log(RT) ~ Condition + (1 | Subject),
               data = sim_data %>% filter(Correct == 1),
               REML = TRUE)

cat("\n=== RT model (correct trials, log-RT) ===\n")
print(summary(mod_rt), correlation = FALSE)


# ── 5c. RT difference: correct vs incorrect ───────────────
# LMM with Correct_f as predictor, all trials
# Random intercept per subject

mod_rt_corr <- lmer(log(RT) ~ Condition * Correct_f + (1 | Subject),
                    data = sim_data,
                    REML = TRUE)

cat("=== RT model: Condition × Correctness ===\n")
print(summary(mod_rt_corr), correlation = FALSE)

# Back-transform coefficients to ms scale for reporting
fe <- fixef(mod_rt_corr)
cat("\n--- Fixed effects (back-transformed to ms scale) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("  Intercept [A, Correct]          : %.1f ms\n", exp(fe[1])))
cat(sprintf("  Condition B vs A                : %+.1f ms\n",
            exp(fe[1]) * (exp(fe[2]) - 1)))
cat(sprintf("  Incorrect vs Correct            : %+.1f ms\n",
            exp(fe[1]) * (exp(fe[3]) - 1)))
```

## A.3 · Conditional accuracy function (CAF)

```{r appendix-caf, fig.height=5}
# CAF: accuracy as a function of RT quintile
# Reveals whether fast responses are less accurate (speed-accuracy trade-off)
# Computed separately per condition

caf_df <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  mutate(
    RT_quintile = ntile(RT, 5)   # 5 equal-frequency bins per subject x condition
  ) %>%
  group_by(Condition, RT_quintile) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy = mean(Correct),
    RT_mean  = mean(RT),
    n        = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

p_caf <- ggplot(caf_df,
                aes(x      = RT_quintile,
                    y      = Accuracy,
                    colour = Condition,
                    group  = Condition)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5,
             linetype   = "dashed",

  labs(title    = "Figure A3 · Conditional Accuracy Function (CAF)",
       subtitle = "Accuracy per RT quintile | Point size ∝ N trials",
       x        = "RT quintile",
       y        = "Accuracy",
       colour   = "Condition") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_caf)
```

## A.4 · Delta plot — RT quantile differences between conditions

```{r appendix-delta, fig.height=5}
# Delta plot: x = mean RT quantile across conditions
#             y = RT difference (B - A) at each quantile
# If the slope is positive, the condition effect grows with RT
# (common in inhibition / conflict paradigms)

delta_df <- sim_data %>%
  filter(Correct == 1) %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    q = list(quantile(RT, probs = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.2))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(q) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = -c(Subject, Condition),
               names_to  = "Quantile",
               values_to = "RT_q") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = Condition,
              values_from = RT_q) %>%
  rename(RT_A = `A (Easy)`,
         RT_B = `B (Hard)`) %>%
  mutate(
    RT_mean  = (RT_A + RT_B) / 2,
    RT_delta = RT_B - RT_A
  ) %>%
  group_by(Quantile) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_x    = mean(RT_mean,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_delta = mean(RT_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_delta  = sd(RT_delta,   na.rm = TRUE) /
                sqrt(sum(!is.na(RT_delta))),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

p_delta <- ggplot(delta_df,
                  aes(x = mean_x, y = mean_delta)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype   = "dashed",
             colour     = "grey50") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_delta - 1.96 * se_delta,
                  ymax = mean_delta + 1.96 * se_delta),
              fill  = "#9ECAE1",
              alpha = 0.40) +
  geom_line(colour    = "#2166AC",
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(colour = "#2166AC",
             size   = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(title    = "Figure A4 · Delta plot: RT(Hard) − RT(Easy) across quantiles",
       subtitle = "Ribbon = 95% CI | Positive slope → condition effect grows for slower responses",
       x        = "Mean RT across conditions (ms)",
       y        = "ΔRT  [B(Hard) − A(Easy)]  (ms)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_delta)
```

# Appendix B · Reporting-ready Summary Table

```{r final-table}
# One clean table: Condition x Response x {N, %, Mean RT, Median RT, SD RT}

final_table <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Condition, Correct_f) %>%
  summarise(
    N          = n(),
    Pct        = n() / nrow(sim_data),
    Mean_RT    = mean(RT),
    Median_RT  = median(RT),
    SD_RT      = sd(RT),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Mean_RT, Median_RT, SD_RT),
                ~ round(.x, 1)),
         Pct = percent(Pct, accuracy = 0.1))

final_table %>%
  kbl(
    caption   = "Table B1 · Full descriptive summary",
    col.names = c("Condition", "Response", "N", "%",
                  "Mean RT (ms)", "Median RT (ms)", "SD RT (ms)"),
    align     = c("l","l","r","r","r","r","r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(final_table$Correct_f == "Correct"),
    background = "#f0f7ff",
    bold       = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(final_table$Correct_f == "Incorrect"),
    color = "grey50"
  ) %>%
  pack_rows("Easy condition",  1, 2) %>%
  pack_rows("Hard condition",  3, 4) %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Correct trials highlighted in blue.",
      "Incorrect trials shown in grey (secondary interest).",
      "RT = Reaction Time in milliseconds."
    ),
    general_title = "Note: "
  )
```

# Appendix C · Effect Size & Power Summary

```{r effect-sizes}
# ── Cohen's d for Condition effect on RT (correct trials) ──
rt_wide <- rt_subj %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = Condition,
              values_from = Median_RT)

d_rt <- (mean(rt_wide$`B (Hard)`) - mean(rt_wide$`A (Easy)`)) /
        sd(rt_wide$`A (Easy)` - rt_wide$`B (Hard)`)

# ── Cohen's d for Condition effect on Accuracy ─────────────
acc_wide <- acc_subj %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = Condition,
              values_from = Accuracy)

d_acc <- (mean(acc_wide$`B (Hard)`) - mean(acc_wide$`A (Easy)`)) /
         sd(acc_wide$`A (Easy)` - acc_wide$`B (Hard)`)

# ── RT difference: correct vs incorrect ────────────────────
rt_corr_vs_inc <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Correct_f) %>%
  summarise(Median_RT = median(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = Correct_f,
              values_from = Median_RT) %>%
  mutate(Delta = Incorrect - Correct)

d_corr_inc <- mean(rt_corr_vs_inc$Delta) /
              sd(rt_corr_vs_inc$Delta)

# ── Summary table ───────────────────────────────────────────
effect_tab <- tibble(
  Comparison              = c(
    "RT: Hard vs Easy (correct trials)",
    "Accuracy: Hard vs Easy",
    "RT: Incorrect vs Correct (all conditions)"
  ),
  Mean_diff = c(
    mean(rt_wide$`B (Hard)` - rt_wide$`A (Easy)`),
    mean(acc_wide$`B (Hard)` - acc_wide$`A (Easy)`),
    mean(rt_corr_vs_inc$Delta)
  ),
  Cohen_d   = c(d_rt, d_acc, d_corr_inc),
  Magnitude = case_when(
    abs(c(d_rt, d_acc, d_corr_inc)) >= 0.8 ~ "Large",
    abs(c(d_rt, d_acc, d_corr_inc)) >= 0.5 ~ "Medium",
    abs(c(d_rt, d_acc, d_corr_inc)) >= 0.2 ~ "Small",
    TRUE                                    ~ "Negligible"
  )
)

effect_tab %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_diff = round(Mean_diff, 3),
    Cohen_d   = round(Cohen_d,   3)
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    caption   = "Table C1 · Effect sizes (Cohen's d, paired)",
    col.names = c("Comparison", "Mean difference",
                  "Cohen's d", "Magnitude"),
    align     = c("l", "r", "r", "l")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  footnote(
    general       = "Cohen's d computed on subject-level paired differences.",
    general_title = "Note: "
  )
```

# Appendix D · Paired t-tests (descriptive, not confirmatory)

```{r paired-ttests}
# Quick paired t-tests as a descriptive complement to the LMMs
# These do NOT replace the mixed models but give an intuitive summary

# ── D1. Accuracy: A vs B ────────────────────────────────────
t_acc <- t.test(
  acc_wide$`A (Easy)`,
  acc_wide$`B (Hard)`,
  paired = TRUE
)

# ── D2. RT (correct): A vs B ────────────────────────────────
t_rt <- t.test(
  rt_wide$`A (Easy)`,
  rt_wide$`B (Hard)`,
  paired = TRUE
)

# ── D3. RT: Correct vs Incorrect ────────────────────────────
t_corr_inc <- t.test(
  rt_corr_vs_inc$Correct,
  rt_corr_vs_inc$Incorrect,
  paired = TRUE
)

# ── Tidy output ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ttest_tab <- tibble(
  Test = c(
    "Accuracy: Easy vs Hard",
    "RT (correct): Easy vs Hard",
    "RT: Correct vs Incorrect"
  ),
  t_stat  = c(t_acc$statistic,
              t_rt$statistic,
              t_corr_inc$statistic),
  df      = c(t_acc$parameter,
              t_rt$parameter,
              t_corr_inc$parameter),
  p_value = c(t_acc$p.value,
              t_rt$p.value,
              t_corr_inc$p.value),
  CI_low  = c(t_acc$conf.int[1],
              t_rt$conf.int[1],
              t_corr_inc$conf.int[1]),
  CI_high = c(t_acc$conf.int[2],
              t_rt$conf.int[2],
              t_corr_inc$conf.int[2])
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< .001",
                          as.character(p_value)))

ttest_tab %>%
  kbl(
    caption   = "Table D1 · Paired t-tests (descriptive summary)",
    col.names = c("Test", "t", "df", "p",
                  "95% CI low", "95% CI high"),
    align     = c("l","r","r","r","r","r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(which(ttest_tab$p_value == "< .001"),
           bold = TRUE) %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Paired t-tests on subject-level means/medians.",
      "Provided as descriptive complement to the LMMs in §5.",
      "Not corrected for multiple comparisons."
    ),
    general_title = "Note: "
  )
```

```{r pub-figure, fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
    shape    = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ── Assemble publication figure ─────────────────────────────
(pA | pB) / (pC | pD) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Reaction Time Experiment — Summary",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "N = ", n_subj, " subjects | ",
      n_trials, " trials/condition | ",
      "Within-subject design | ",
      "Condition: Easy vs Hard"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Panels A–B: primary outcomes (accuracy & correct-trial RT).",
      "Panel C: RT distributions, correct (solid) vs incorrect (dashed).",
      "Panel D: individual speed–accuracy trade-off.",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey40"),
      plot.caption  = element_text(size  = 9,  colour = "grey55",
                                   hjust = 0,  lineheight = 1.4)
    )
  )
```

# Appendix F · Inverse Efficiency Score (IES)

```{r ies, fig.height=5}
# IES = Mean RT (correct) / Accuracy
# Combines speed and accuracy into a single index:
#   lower IES = better performance
# Townsend & Ashby (1983)

ies_df <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_RT_correct = mean(RT[Correct == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    Accuracy        = mean(Correct),
    IES             = Mean_RT_correct / Accuracy,
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

ies_summary <- ies_df %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    IES_mean = mean(IES),
    IES_se   = sd(IES) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

# ── F1. IES per subject ──────────────────────────────────────
p_ies_lines <- ggplot(ies_df,
                      aes(x = Condition, y = IES,
                          group = Subject)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey40", size = 1.8, alpha = 0.65) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun     = mean,
    fun.min = function(x) mean(x) - sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)),
    fun.max = function(x) mean(x) + sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)),
    geom    = "pointrange",
    colour  = "#7B2D8B",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    size    = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(
    title    = "A · IES per subject",
    subtitle = "Grey = subjects | Purple = mean ± SE | Lower = better",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "IES (ms / accuracy)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ── F2. IES raincloud ────────────────────────────────────────
p_ies_rain <- ggplot(ies_df,
                     aes(x      = Condition,
                         y      = IES,
                         fill   = Condition,
                         colour = Condition)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust       = 0.8,
    width        = 0.5,
    .width       = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    position     = position_nudge(x = 0.18),
    alpha        = 0.70
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width         = 0.18,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha         = 0.50,
    colour        = "grey30",
    position      = position_nudge(x = -0.12)
  ) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, size = 2, alpha = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("A (Easy)" = "#C994C7",
               "B (Hard)" = "#7B2D8B")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("A (Easy)" = "#984EA3",
               "B (Hard)" = "#49006A")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(
    title    = "B · IES distribution",
    subtitle = "Box | Points | Density",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_ies_lines + p_ies_rain +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure F1 · Inverse Efficiency Score (IES) by Condition",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
  )
```

# Appendix G · Correct-trial RT split by preceding trial outcome

```{r post-error, fig.height=5}
# Post-error slowing (PES):
# Is RT on trial N slower when trial N-1 was incorrect?
# Classic finding in cognitive control research

pes_df <- sim_data %>%
  arrange(Subject, Condition, Trial) %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_correct = lag(Correct_f, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    Correct    == 1,              # current trial correct only
    !is.na(Prev_correct)          # exclude first trial
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_correct = factor(
      Prev_correct,
      levels = c("Correct", "Incorrect"),
      labels = c("Post-correct", "Post-error")
    )
  )

# Subject-level medians
pes_subj <- pes_df %>%
  group_by(Subject, Condition, Prev_correct) %>%
  summarise(Median_RT = median(RT), .groups = "drop")

p_pes <- ggplot(pes_subj,
                aes(x      = Prev_correct,
                    y      = Median_RT,
                    fill   = Prev_correct,
                    colour = Prev_correct)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust       = 0.8,
    width        = 0.45,
    .width       = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    position     = position_nudge(x = 0.15),
    alpha        = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width         = 0.16,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha         = 0.45,
    colour        = "grey30",
    position      = position_nudge(x = -0.10)
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = Subject),
    colour    = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha     = 0.60
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.65) +
  facet_wrap(~ Condition, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Post-correct" = "#9ECAE1",
               "Post-error"   = "#FC8D59"),
    name   = "Previous trial"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Post-correct" = "#2166AC",
               "Post-error"   = "#D7301F"),
    name   = "Previous trial"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format(suffix = " ms")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Figure G1 · Post-error slowing (correct trials only)",
    subtitle = "RT on trial N as a function of trial N−1 outcome",
    x        = "Previous trial outcome",
    y        = "Median RT (ms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", colour = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_pes)
```

# Appendix H · Save all figures

```{r save-figures, eval=FALSE}
# ── Helper: save with consistent settings ───────────────────
save_fig <- function(plot, filename,
                     width  = 12,
                     height = 8,
                     dpi    = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("figures", filename),
    plot     = plot,
    width    = width,
    height   = height,
    dpi      = dpi,
    bg       = "white"
  )
  message("Saved: ", filename)
}
```

# Appendix I · Reproducibility Checklist

```{r reproducibility}
# ── I.1  Confirm all key objects exist ──────────────────────
required_objects <- c(
  "sim_data",       # full dataset
  "rt_correct",     # correct trials only
  "acc_subj",       # subject x condition accuracy
  "rt_subj",        # subject x condition median RT
  "tradeoff_df",    # speed-accuracy trade-off data
  "ies_df",         # inverse efficiency scores
  "pes_df",         # post-error slowing data
  "mod_acc",        # logistic GLMM (accuracy)
  "mod_rt",         # LMM (RT, correct trials)
  "mod_rt_corr"     # LMM (RT, correctness x condition)
)

check_df <- tibble(
  Object  = required_objects,
  Exists  = sapply(required_objects, exists),
  Class   = sapply(required_objects, function(x)
              if (exists(x)) class(get(x))[1] else NA_character_),
  N_rows  = sapply(required_objects, function(x)
              if (exists(x) && is.data.frame(get(x)))
                nrow(get(x))
              else NA_integer_)
)

check_df %>%
  kbl(
    caption   = "Table I1 · Reproducibility checklist",
    col.names = c("Object", "Exists", "Class", "N rows"),
    align     = c("l", "c", "l", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(!check_df$Exists),
    background = "#fff0f0",
    color      = "red"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(check_df$Exists),
    background = "#f0fff0"
  )

# ── I.2  Dataset snapshot ────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Dataset snapshot ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total rows          : %d\n",  nrow(sim_data)))
cat(sprintf("  Subjects            : %d\n",  n_distinct(sim_data$Subject)))
cat(sprintf("  Conditions          : %d (%s)\n",
            n_distinct(sim_data$Condition),
            paste(levels(sim_data$Condition), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  Trials per cell     : %d\n",  n_trials))
cat(sprintf("  Overall accuracy    : %.1f%%\n",
            mean(sim_data$Correct) * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Mean RT (all)       : %.1f ms\n", mean(sim_data$RT)))
cat(sprintf("  Mean RT (correct)   : %.1f ms\n",
            mean(sim_data$RT[sim_data$Correct == 1])))
cat(sprintf("  Mean RT (incorrect) : %.1f ms\n",
            mean(sim_data$RT[sim_data$Correct == 0])))
cat(sprintf("  RT difference       : %.1f ms (incorrect - correct)\n",
            mean(sim_data$RT[sim_data$Correct == 0]) -
            mean(sim_data$RT[sim_data$Correct == 1])))
```
